info.title: VH Health API
info.description: VH Health platform REST API. Paths are generated from the live Express router by scripts/generate-openapi.mjs and gated by scripts/check-openapi-drift.mjs. Operation request/response payloads are enriched per subsystem in later phases — see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-24-openapi-contract-pipeline-design.md.

BookAppointmentRequest.description: POST /api/v1/appointments/book. Accepts date/time/phone aliases; patient_id is derived from JWT for PATIENT callers or resolved from patient_phone.

BulkUpdateStatusRequest.description: POST /api/v1/appointments/admin/bulk-update-status. Exactly one appointment may be cancelled or marked no-show; clinician-owned completion returns 409.

CollectAdvanceRequest.description: Reverse-engineered from billingV2Service.collectAdvance; not validator-backed. Requires X-Idempotency-Key header.

CreateDischargeDraftRequest.description: POST /api/v1/discharge-summaries. Creates a draft; admission_id/template_code/specialty optional.

attested.description: Explicit clinician confirmation of the electronic attestation statement.

EditPayslipRequest.description: Reverse-engineered from payrollController.manualEditPayslip; not validator-backed. Per-component overrides + edit_reason.

oneOf.description: Decimal string when the identifier exceeds the JavaScript safe-integer range.

LabI01RecoveryEnvelope.description: Owner-authorized I01 backlog envelope. OBR-7 is the explicit occurrence authority; late results create a no-SLA human-review task and never retrospective pathway, SLA, or notification effects.

LabI02RecoveryEnvelope.description: Owner-authorized I02 backlog envelope. Source occurrence is explicit because ASTM carries no governed occurrence timestamp; canonical ASTM bytes bind replay identity.

message.description: HL7 ORU^R01 payload. Local investigation references in ORC-2/OBR-2 must use VHINV-<positive PostgreSQL integer>. Bare numeric, malformed VHINV, and reserved VHBOOK identifiers are rejected. A VHINV-linked single-analyte message requires exact investigations.test_code equality with the OBR-4 and every OBX-3 code component. Unrecognized external alphanumeric identifiers remain unlinked shadow data.

patient_uid.description: Compatibility assertion only; ownership is derived from locked tenant rows.

MarkLinkPaidRequest.description: Reverse-engineered from paymentLinkService.markPaymentLinkPaid; not validator-backed. Requires Idempotency-Key header.

MarkRefundPaidRequest.description: Reverse-engineered from billingV2Service.markRefundPaid; not validator-backed. Requires X-Idempotency-Key header.

firebaseIdToken.description: Fresh Firebase ID token from an OTP re-authentication challenge.

reason.description: Optional operator-facing deletion reason; defaults to patient_self_service.

min_patient_version_code.description: Minimum accepted patient app build number. 0 disables the hard upgrade gate.

next_steps.description: Reserved for next steps backed by an exact live domain source. Immutable OP closure snapshots are not exposed.

ResolveConflictRequest.description: POST /api/v1/appointments/admin/resolve-conflict. conflict_appointments must be exactly 2 ids.

RevisionSignRequest.description: Reverse-engineered from salaryRevisionController hr-sign / admin-sign; not validator-backed.

SettleAdvanceRequest.description: Reverse-engineered from billingV2Service.settleAdvance; not validator-backed. Requires X-Idempotency-Key header.

SignDischargeRequest.description: POST /api/v1/discharge-summaries/{id}/sign. Both fields optional; signed_by_name falls back to req.user.name.

SignPayrollRunRequest.description: Reverse-engineered from payrollController.hrSignPayrollRun / adminSignPayrollRun; not validator-backed.

UpsertPayerRequest.description: Reverse-engineered from billingMastersService.upsertPayer; service-layer validation, not express-validator.

WalkInRequest.description: POST /api/v1/appointments/walk-in. Wide front-desk intake; most fields optional with aliases. patient_phone OR patient_id is required (relaxed for unidentified-ER mode).

get.summary: Read the latest care-pathway reconciliation evidence
get.description: Returns PHI-free append-only evidence for the request tenant. SUPER_ADMIN cross-tenant access requires the audited x-tenant-id override and reason headers.

get.summary: Read care-pathway reconciliation evidence history
get.description: Returns paginated PHI-free append-only evidence ordered newest first. This endpoint has no mutation, retry, redrive, reset, reassign, dismiss, pass, or mode-change operation.

oneOf.description: Decimal string when the identifier exceeds the JavaScript safe-integer range.

post.summary: Record an audited inpatient follow-up exception
post.description: Records an explicit reason when the admission has no booked follow-up and returns only the canonical staff-safe evidence identifiers.

post.summary: Record a named-owner handoff for a pending result
post.description: Creates an exact-lineage handoff to the current primary physician. An idempotent replay also returns 201 with the same strict staff-safe handoff view.

post.summary: Cross-sign an available pending result as its named discharge owner
post.description: Requires the live named discharge physician to attest the exact latest signed generation and its ordering-owner doctor disposition. The signed append-only receipt atomically resolves the handoff and its current parent and child tasks. Exact replay is safe after later rearm.

post.summary: Mark an exact pending result as available
post.description: Marks the handed-off result generation available and returns the strict handoff plus a newly created review task. A repeated call returns 200 with action_task null when that open task already exists.

put.summary: Record pending-result inclusion in a signed summary
put.description: Links the exact pending-result handoff to the signed structured discharge summary and returns the strict staff-safe handoff view.

get.summary: Read inpatient pending-result and discharge evidence
get.description: Returns exact admission-scoped pending-result lineage, named ownership, signed-summary inclusion, and active discharge blockers without result content.

get.summary: List post-discharge contact evidence
get.description: Returns the admission-scoped, patient-safe contact timeline without recorder, idempotency, audit, or arbitrary metadata fields.

post.summary: Record patient-safe post-discharge contact evidence
post.description: Records an admission-scoped contact attempt or outcome. An idempotent replay also returns 201 with the same patient-safe contact view.

post.summary: Record patient-safe OP visit closure evidence
post.description: Records the clinician disposition and patient-safe next steps. A new record returns 201; an idempotent replay returns the same typed payload with 200.

post.summary: Request an OP-to-inpatient named-recipient transfer
post.description: Creates one exact-lineage handoff and review task. A new request returns 201; an idempotent replay returns the same strict staff-safe payload with 200.

post.summary: Accept an OP-to-inpatient named-recipient transfer
post.description: Accepts the exact handoff as its intended recipient and returns the strict admission-source tuple. A new acceptance and an idempotent replay both return 200.

get.summary: Read appointment pathway work and closure readiness
get.description: Returns the staff-safe OP work projection, named ownership, completion gates, and any recorded patient-safe closure evidence.

get.summary: Read an exact-recipient covering-clinician transfer
get.description: Returns the minimal patient and pathway context needed by the exact intended clinician to review a covering-transfer request. Terminal states require coherent immutable transition evidence and remain non-enumerable by handoff UUID.

post.summary: Accept a covering-clinician transfer
post.description: Lets only the exact intended clinician accept a live covering-transfer request. Acceptance atomically transfers pathway, actionable-task, and incomplete-SLA ownership and records immutable evidence.

post.summary: Cancel a covering-clinician transfer request
post.description: Lets only the unchanged current pathway owner cancel their pending covering-transfer request with a reason. Cancelling never changes pathway ownership.

post.summary: Decline a covering-clinician transfer
post.description: Lets only the exact intended clinician decline a requested covering transfer with a reason. Declining never changes pathway ownership.

post.summary: Create a governed care pathway instance
post.description: Creates one tenant-scoped pathway instance from an approved workflow definition. Manual ownership is derived from the authenticated actor.

get.summary: Retrieve a care pathway instance and its runtime state
get.description: Returns the pathway instance with its workflow run, steps, tasks, approvals, and handoffs.

post.summary: Claim a role-owned care pathway instance
post.description: Atomically assigns the live role-owned pathway instance, every actionable pathway task, and every corresponding incomplete SLA to the authenticated clinician only while their current database role exactly matches the queue.

post.summary: Submit an idempotent command to a care pathway instance
post.description: Submits a user-authored signal to the current governed pathway stage. Source lineage fields are reserved for registered system actors and are not accepted here.

post.summary: Request an accepted covering-clinician transfer
post.description: Creates an exact-recipient covering-transfer request and review task. The current owner remains responsible until the intended clinician accepts.

get.summary: Fetch exact signed clinical continuity action-policy bytes
get.description: Authenticated Staff delivery of the canonical signed policy envelope for one AF-authorized facility.

post.summary: Record a doctor-signed diagnostic result action
post.description: Completes only the current doctor-owned domain-evidence task and atomically records the disposition, signature, pathway transition, and minimal-PHI event.

post.summary: Reopen an auto-closed normal diagnostic result
post.description: Allows the exact current pathway owner to preserve the prior closure and create a new doctor-review obligation with an audited reason.

post.summary: Acknowledge a clinical inbox task
post.description: Stops the linked escalation clock only when the caller has task assignment, assigned-role, task-administrator, or durable patient break-glass authority.

post.summary: Claim a role-owned clinical inbox task
post.description: Atomically assigns an actionable role-queue task to the authenticated clinician only while their current database role still exactly matches the queue. Claiming does not acknowledge or complete the task or its linked SLA.

get.summary: List ED destination handoffs visible to the authenticated actor
get.description: Returns handoffs sent by the actor or assigned to the actor current exact database role.

post.summary: Record an append-only ED branch closure revision
post.description: Records exact discharge, LAMA, LWBS, external-transfer, or death closure evidence as the named ED clinician. A new revision returns 201 and exact idempotent replay returns 200.

get.summary: Read exact ED destination, closure, and recovery evidence
get.description: Returns staff-only ED branch readiness, append-only closure revisions, and recovery contacts. Patient-safe aftercare is projected separately through the patient care-plan API.

post.summary: Request an ED receiving-destination role handoff
post.description: Creates an exact ED-pathway handoff and role-owned review task without inventing an SLA. A new request returns 201; an idempotent replay returns 200.

post.summary: Accept or decline an ED destination handoff
post.description: Allows an active holder of the exact assigned database role to accept or decline the handoff. A decline requires a reason.

post.summary: Reroute a declined ED destination handoff
post.description: Allows only the unchanged ED pathway owner to replace one declined handoff with a new explicit destination and role request.

post.summary: Record an append-only LAMA or LWBS recovery event
post.description: Records a policy-neutral contact attempt or clinician outcome against the latest exact LAMA or LWBS closure revision. No timer or attempt threshold is invented.

get.summary: Confirm authenticated client drain readiness
get.description: Low-information authenticated proof of endpoint route, tenant, database, policy compatibility, and server time.

put.description: The authenticated current database actor is recorded as the technical result recorder. reviewed_by and other caller-supplied reviewer identities are rejected and this command does not constitute doctor countersignature.

post.summary: Ingest an ASTM E1394 analyzer message
post.description: ASTM-only analyzer inbox. Optional I02 recovery adapts the migration-583 receipt and requires an owner-authorized high-water marker; recovered critical results create no retrospective SLA/pathway/notification effects. HL7 ORU messages must use /api/v1/lab/oru/ingest.

post.summary: Ingest an authenticated HL7 ORU result message
post.description: Uses the immutable migration-582 sender/message-control replay claim. Optional I01 recovery requires an owner-authorized high-water marker and creates result plus no-SLA human-review evidence without retrospective SLA/pathway/notification effects. Local orders are table-explicit: VHINV-<id> resolves only investigations and requires exact structured analyte identity. No VHBOOK producer is currently supported.

post.summary: Sign one laboratory result episode
post.description: Requires a stable Idempotency-Key, a database-current pathologist-tier actor, one tenant/patient/source episode, and a legal initial or corrective generation state.

post.summary: Record a manual laboratory result
post.description: Requires a stable Idempotency-Key so retries cannot duplicate the result, canonical evidence, or critical-result obligations.

200.description: The authenticated patient’s safe live goals and follow-up plans.

get.summary: Get the patient-safe What’s Next projection
get.description: Returns live patient-visible goals and follow-up plans. The reserved next_steps array remains empty until each step type has an exact live-domain source and satisfaction rule. Raw workflow tasks, immutable closure snapshots, blocker text, staff comments, ward notes, and ownership evidence are never returned.

200.description: Signed outpatient appointment-bound notes visible to the authenticated patient.

get.summary: List patient-visible OP consultation notes
get.description: Patient portal clinical-note reads return only signed outpatient notes with a first-class clinical_notes.appointment_id link. Inpatient, ward, case-sheet, procedure, discharge-source, and legacy JSON/time-window-linked notes are intentionally excluded. The optional note_type filter is intersected with the patient-visible vocabulary; unsupported values return an empty list.

parameters.name: note_type
parameters.description: Optional patient-visible note type filter. Unsupported values intentionally return an empty data array.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of notes to return.

200.description: Signed outpatient notes linked to the requested appointment.

get.summary: List OP notes for one appointment
get.description: Patient portal clinical-note reads return only signed outpatient notes with a first-class clinical_notes.appointment_id link. Inpatient, ward, case-sheet, procedure, discharge-source, and legacy JSON/time-window-linked notes are intentionally excluded. Appointment-scoped reads require clinical_notes.appointment_id to equal the path appointmentId; embedded JSON appointment ids and date-window fallbacks are not used.
